tools.name: search_vocabulary
tools.title: Search HSK vocabulary
tools.description: Search the HSK 1-6 vocabulary bank of HSK Hub by hanzi, pinyin or English meaning. Optionally filter by HSK level.

query.description: Hanzi, pinyin or English meaning to search for. Leave empty to browse by level.

limit.description: Maximum number of words to return (default 20, max 100).

tools.name: search_grammar
tools.title: Search HSK grammar points
tools.description: Search HSK Hub's HSK 1-6 grammar reference by pattern, name or explanation, with structure formula and examples.

query.description: Pattern, keyword or English explanation to search for. Leave empty to browse by level.

limit.description: Maximum number of grammar points to return (default 10, max 40).

tools.name: list_dictation_videos
tools.title: List dictation videos
tools.description: Browse HSK Hub's Chinese dictation (听写) library: title, level, topic category, duration and number of practice sentences.

query.description: Filter by title text (Chinese or Vietnamese).

level.description: Level filter: beginner, intermediate or advanced.

category.description: Category filter: news, vlog, cartoon, drama, education, history, discovery, other.

limit.description: Maximum number of videos to return (default 25, max 100).

tools.name: get_dictation_transcript
tools.title: Get dictation transcript
tools.description: Return the sentence-by-sentence Chinese transcript (with Vietnamese translation when available) of one dictation video from HSK Hub. Use list_dictation_videos first to get the video id.

videoId.description: The dictation entry id returned by list_dictation_videos.

from.description: First sentence index to return (0-based, default 0).

count.description: How many sentences to return (default 40, max 200).

tools.name: get_province
tools.title: Explore a Chinese province
tools.description: Look up one of China's 34 provincial-level units in HSK Hub's 探索中国 dataset: capital, population, area, cuisine, landmarks, universities and the Chinese reading passage when available. Omit the name to list all units.

name.description: Province name in Chinese, pinyin or Vietnamese. Omit to list every unit.

tools.name: list_saved_words
tools.title: List my saved words
tools.description: List the signed-in user's saved vocabulary notebook (生词本) entries from HSK Hub.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default 50, max 200).

tools.name: save_word
tools.title: Save a word to my notebook
tools.description: Add a Chinese word, phrase or sentence (with an optional note) to the signed-in user's HSK Hub 生词本.

text.description: The Chinese word, phrase or sentence to save.

tools.name: list_exam_results
tools.title: List my mock exam results
tools.description: List the signed-in user's HSK mock exam results from HSK Hub, newest first, with score per section.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 20, max 100).
